title: River Development Agent Controlled Executor Dispatch Boundary Foundation
objective: Establish a deterministic, fail-closed controlled executor dispatch boundary that may admit an already dispatch-authorized inert invocation request into a dispatch-ready envelope while preserving authorization provenance and exact approved execution scope. This phase must not invoke an executor, execute an operation, modify repository state, create authorization, expand scope, or perform external side effects.

admissionSemantics.authorizedMeaning: The exact invocation request has passed the separately governed DEV-254 dispatch authorization decision and is eligible to enter this inert dispatch boundary.
admissionSemantics.admittedMeaning: The exact authorized invocation request has been deterministically admitted into an inert dispatch-ready envelope.
admissionSemantics.notAuthorizedMeaning: The request must fail closed and cannot enter the dispatch boundary.
admissionSemantics.notAdmittedMeaning: No executor invocation or side effect may occur.

requiredPredecessorEvidence: DEV-254 approved execution scope remains present
implementationConstraints: No modification of protected integration surfaces.
The output must remain inert data.
acceptanceCriteria: DEV-255 begins directly from DEV-254 commit 1fe7ec3.
The dispatch boundary defaults to DENY.
Only a trusted, ready, dispatch-authorized DEV-254 decision may be admitted.
Missing approved execution scope causes denial.
Approved execution scope is preserved exactly.
The dispatch boundary cannot create authorization.
The dispatch boundary cannot expand scope.
The dispatch boundary cannot invoke an executor.
The dispatch boundary cannot execute an operation.
The dispatch boundary cannot modify repository state.
A future executor remains separately required for all side effects.
